description:
Sarsabz Fertilizer proudly continues its tradition of honoring the relentless dedication of farmers, the backbone of our nation, who tirelessly fuel our prosperity. Join us in saluting the resilience and spirit of these farming heroes as we celebrate Kissan Day on December 18th. We recognize and stand by our farmers, commemorating their hard work and unwavering commitment that drives our nation forward.

#SalamKissan #SarsabzPakistan #KissanDay

Produced by: Azadfilm Company 
Directed by: Jami (DGP Member) 
Music composer: Shani Haider
Lyrics by: Sabir Zafar
Singers: Shani Haider and Nirmila
Brands Team: Haris Ahmed Khan, Noor Malik, Mahru Abid and Haris Malik
